notes: Marital status (3 groups) is also tested by chi-square but is not treated as an SPD, so it has no groupwise entry. CPS proportions serve only as weighting targets, not as an analyzed data source. Design mapped from 'survey' to cross-sectional.
view_issues: The text averages four Likert items into one support measure, yet the table reports categorical support levels; how the averaged score was categorized is not stated. The text says 'men' were more supportive, but the gender identity test covers three groups including 'Other' (n=10).
